verdict.rationale: ernd is a corporate card for AI vendor spend, and accounting-system sync is a fair question for corporate card products, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only rewards, partner perks, sign-up and withdrawals. It says nothing about syncing transactions to QuickBooks, NetSuite or Xero, or about GL account, class or department mappings.

support.subject: As a finance lead, transactions sync to QuickBooks, NetSuite, or Xero with GL account, class, and department mappings I control
